F2-54.title: Figure 2-54: Typical DPT Signatures (printed 2-92, PDF 117)
F2-54.legend_hint: the record box printed beside each trace
F2-54.notes_for_reviewers: Three oscillograph records of the dynamic penetrometer hitting soil: deceleration against time, one solid trace per record, stacked top to bottom. Printed sideways; the packet shows it turned upright. Each trace has its own ruler of G's and a dashed line drawn just above the trace's zero; the vertical lines are timing lines 0.01 s apart. Each trace leaves its flat start, rises steeply to a peak and falls back. Where the trace runs along the dashed line or crosses a timing line, a crosshair on the dashed line or the timing line rather than the trace is a no; so is a crosshair on a ruler tick or a label.
